title: Optimal labeling
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and suppose the label set $\\{0,\\ldots,q-1\\}$ is nonempty. An optimal labeling of $G$ assigns a label from this set to every vertex, according to an assignment maximizing the associated constraint satisfaction objective.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
